scenes.html:
clify agent

An AI agent with its own cloud computer, email address and accounts.
Email it a job: it asks when unsure, does it on the web with clify,
and replies in the same thread.

InstaBox: its computer
Primitive: its inbox
Inkbox: its identity + peer agent
clify: the web as CLIs
Claude Opus 5.5

scenes.meta: Maya (test requester) ⇄ clify agent · 6 emails · one thread

captions.1: Ambiguous → one question, in the same thread
captions.2: Her answer continues the same job
captions.3: clify on the InstaBox → CSV attached
captions.4: A follow-up in the same thread
captions.5: Uptime check + public status page, made on its own updown account

scenes.meta: Leo (test requester) ⇄ clify agent ⇄ peer agent (Inkbox) · forward = delegation

captions.1: Forward = delegation: the thread goes to the peer agent
captions.2: The peer answers in the forwarded thread, CSV attached
captions.3: One merged answer back to Leo

scenes.meta: Sam (test requester) ⇄ clify agent · blocked → ask the human, cc the peer

captions.1: CAPTCHA → it emails its human, cc the peer. It never solves one.

scenes.html:
Always on

Two agents as systemd services on the InstaBox, each with its own vault.
Full stop/start: back in 5 s, next job handled.

$ instabox stop clify-agent && instabox start clify-agent

clify-agent@peer  active   2 jobs reloaded
